conflictOfInterest.details: Founding-stage operational conflict: github:VSBDev operated the authoring and packaging agents and also operates this learning-design review run. This is a new role-isolated run with a unique run ID; it had no access to the authoring conversation. The conflict is disclosed rather than treated as independent human peer review.

findings.finding: The lesson's version is declared as 0.2.0 in the lesson metadata files (lesson.json, claims.json, references.json, glossary.json, and assessment.json), but the text on line 5 of ATTRIBUTION.md still declares the lesson version as 0.1.0.
findings.resolution: Update version 0.1.0 to 0.2.0 on line 5 of ATTRIBUTION.md to maintain consistency with the rest of the lesson pack metadata.

findings.finding: The clinical wrap-up in scene 7 successfully integrates the lesson's target core concepts (operational definitions, repeatability vs reproducibility, scatter vs shift, and construct validity) in a clinical diabetes context (fasting glucose and dinner timing), without introducing clinical treatment advice or pre-existing clinical datasets.

The lesson is highly aligned with CONTENT-STANDARD.md. The worked example in scene 3 includes all 9 required parts, including a self-explanation prompt. The practice sequence correctly fades support from calculation-based precision comparisons to independent construct audits. The transfer task in scene 5 and transfer assessment item in assessment.json correctly test the concepts in entirely novel domains (team coordination and greenhouse seedling vigor, respectively) rather than merely changing numbers.

limitations: The accountable operator conflict is material even though this run was role-isolated; this artifact is not independent human peer review.
No learner-performance data or classroom trials exist for these fictional cases; the review evaluates internal learning design and alignment, not actual student outcomes.
The reviewer is an AI agent system and does not represent a real human student's cognitive processing or first-hand experience.
This review targets candidate commit b47e716fe022788280765faaf74c2e54614fd35a only.
